title: Skeleton: who stands behind NEAR’s validators?
question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with the signature each completion got. A hash or link the model copied from a tool result is written as a reference to that result ($from, {{…}}), so it replays on recordedClient.

turns.content: I'll start by finding the NEAR network and checking what flowers already exist.
Network is `near-validators`. Let me check existing flowers and get the snapshot.
Snapshot is the stored fixture (reused: true), final at block 222,915,356, as_of 2026-11-03. Now the measures and figures:
The fixture is final and reused, so this is a fresh analysis of the same snapshot. Proposing with `segments: "backers"`:

interpretation.summary: NEAR's validator stake is spread thin at the top but broad at the base: the largest pool, astro-stakers.poolv1.near, holds only 5.6% of the 593.4M NEAR staked this epoch. Nine pools together pass a third of stake. Behind each pool sit delegators, and the flower splits every pool's delegations into four backer classes so you can see whether a pool is retail, large holders, liquid staking or lockups. Several of the biggest pools are operator brands (Figment, Binance, Bitwise) that appear as separate pool accounts.

power_means.claim: Power here is stake delegated to a validator this epoch; no single pool dominates, and the top 10 hold 36.2% of stake.
The base is long: 311 pools share 13.8% of stake, and Gini over included participants is 0.836.
Behind each pool are delegations from other delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts and lockups; these classes are what the segments show.

mappings.why: Each petal's bar is divided by who delegated to that pool: other delegators, 1M+ NEAR accounts, liquid-staking contracts, or lockups, with sub-1,000 NEAR rows folded per pool and class.
Square root of the pool's share of current-epoch stake, so mid-sized pools stay legible next to the largest.
Share of stake this epoch compressed into a 2x band, so the sides stay comparable without one pool swallowing the shape.
Kind of account, to separate staking pools from liquid-staking contracts and unknowns.
Solid where the pool's name is self-declared or verified, dashed where inferred, none where unknown.
Largest stake first, clockwise from the top.

conflicts: Stake is one kind of power; governance weight (veNEAR in House of Stake) and pool ownership/operator control are separate, and this flower draws stake and its backers only.
unknowns: Liquid-staking contracts appear as single delegators; their own token holders (the real ultimate backers) are not listed.
Owners of lockup contracts were not resolved, so a lockup's beneficiary is unknown.
424 idle pools were not crawled, so their delegators are missing from the backer split.
Pool names are self-declared in pool-details.near; they are not verified identities.
Addresses are not people: backer categories are account classes, not natural persons.
inferred: Grouping Figment, Binance and Bitwise pool accounts under one operator brand is an inference from account naming, not a proven common owner.

**Flower:** [{{chatcmpl-tool-8169dcea4c3a56a6.view_url}}]({{chatcmpl-tool-8169dcea4c3a56a6.view_url}})

Fresh reading of the stored fixture — final snapshot at block 222,915,356, as_of 2026-11-03 (reused, `reused: true`). A published version of this question already exists (id `9ac16c89…` by elcocoel.testnet); this is a new build, as you asked.

**What you'll see:** 60 pool petals. Each bar is split by *who delegated* to that pool — other delegators, accounts holding 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts, or lockups. Stake is spread: the top pool is astro-stakers.poolv1.near at 5.6%, top 10 = 36.2%, 9 pools cross a third. 311 pools share the last 13.8%.

**Mapping**
- **segments** — who stands behind each pool (other delegators / 1M+ NEAR / liquid staking / lockups), sub-1,000 NEAR rows folded per pool and class — `fastnear-rpc-staking-pool-views`
- **height** — √share of current-epoch stake — `fastnear-rpc-validators`
- **width** — share, in a 2× band — `fastnear-rpc-validators`
- **colour** — kind of account (pool / liquid staking) — `nearblocks-validators`
- **outline** — solid where self-declared — `account-id`
- **tail** — the remaining 311 grouped, 13.8%

**Changed from default:** segments → backers.

**What this can't tell you:** liquid-staking contracts are one delegator each — their token holders, the real ultimate backers, aren't listed; lockup owners aren't resolved; 424 idle pools weren't crawled; names are self-declared, not verified; accounts aren't people.
